test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 02 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) DA−BY​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34e57ce1d79e3790da1a804607a22f94b32c119d97246ad9badf61fc1bb54a6f.png] 

Option 2) CZ−AX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/408df048dc6f24a8ed23f4405b6b4d61e6a05ba719ca937294df00d06f2ab038.png] 

Option 3) GD−EB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b864705dc2d7602ec13a69cdf870b9c82f9060145cd4a6cd1079a6a64c7e4a6.png] 

Option 4) CZ−ZZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99d981b396d7705376fdc9fac8bc5448efaa6e8329531a3fd1f9c98c8a73bc17.png] 

Thus, "CZ−ZZ" is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
